<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejectionReasons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RejectionReviewed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DecideRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RequestDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateHRNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteManagementProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestDecision" name="Request approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRequest" name="Return application to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed" name="Rejection reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Register" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notification_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_VacationRequest" name="Vacation request process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitVacationRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive request by immediate supervisor">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestDecision" name="Request approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnApplication" name="Return application to applicant / employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed" name="Rejection reasons reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_VacationRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitVacationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="Task_SubmitVacationRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReturnApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notification_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
